Doc ID: RM-DOC-0110
Title: Correction: share of Brenmark electronics imports using the canal
Outlet: Runewire
Publication Date: 2025-03-09
Source Type: correction
Event ID: EVT-A
Country: Brenmark
Sector: electronics
Reliability Tier: 2

Correction. An earlier Runewire report, RM-DOC-0102 of 2025-03-03, overstated the share of Brenmark's electronics imports that use the Serpent Canal.

The correct figure is 55 percent of Brenmark's electronics imports by value, according to the revised port data.
